newsitem.title: USA: AMEX to list ACNielsen, Cognizant options.
newsitem.headline: AMEX to list ACNielsen, Cognizant options.

text.p: The American Stock Exchange (AMEX) said Tuesday it would list options on shares of ACNielsen Corp and Cognizant Corp on November 4.
The two companies are spinoffs from Dun & Bradstreet Corp and are scheduled to become independent on November 1.
The AMEX said ACNielsen will have opening strike prices of 15, 17-1/2 and 20, with initial expirations of November, December, February and May.
Cognizant will open with strikes of 30, 35 and 40, and expirations of November, December, February and May.
Letco-Specialist LP will be the specialist for the options.
